def _load_instrument_style_measurement(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Load the bounded right-side red/brown re-detection artifacts."""

    resolved = root.resolve(strict=True)
    brown_image = (
        resolved
        / "instrument_style_self_detection"
        / "02_仪器风格BROWN底图_自有算法重新检测结果.png"
    ).resolve(strict=True)
    red_image = (
        resolved
        / "instrument_style_self_detection"
        / "06_仪器风格RED底图_自有红区实例重新检测结果.png"
    ).resolve(strict=True)
    brown_metrics_path = (resolved / "brown_recomputed_metrics.json").resolve(strict=True)
    red_metrics_path = (resolved / "red_recomputed_metrics.json").resolve(strict=True)
    lineage_path = (resolved / "measurement_lineage.json").resolve(strict=True)
    receipt_path = (resolved / "validation_receipt.json").resolve(strict=True)
    for path in (
        brown_image,
        red_image,
        brown_metrics_path,
        red_metrics_path,
        lineage_path,
        receipt_path,
    ):
        if not path.is_relative_to(resolved) or path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError(f"instrument-style artifact escaped root: {path}")
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if receipt.get("status") != "PASS":
        raise ValueError(f"instrument-style measurement did not pass: {resolved}")
    if not receipt.get("checks", {}).get("instrument_style_images_used_as_detector_inputs"):
        raise ValueError("instrument-style detector-input proof is missing")
    if receipt.get("checks", {}).get("old_masks_read") or receipt.get("checks", {}).get("old_metrics_read"):
        raise ValueError("left-side legacy mask or metrics entered the right-side run")
    return {
        "brown_image": brown_image,
        "red_image": red_image,
        "brown": json.loads(brown_metrics_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["metrics"],
        "red": json.loads(red_metrics_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["metrics"],
        "brown_metrics_path": brown_metrics_path,
        "red_metrics_path": red_metrics_path,
        "lineage_path": lineage_path,
        "receipt_path": receipt_path,
    }


def _apply_instrument_style_red_brown(
    payload: dict[str, Any],
    measurement: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Atomically replace only the formal Brown/Red image-and-metric pairs."""

    brown = measurement["brown"]
    red = measurement["red"]
    brown_image = measurement["brown_image"]
    red_image = measurement["red_image"]

    pigment = _module(payload, "03")
    groups = pigment.get("医生结果分组") or []
    if len(groups) != 5:
        raise ValueError("formal module 03 must retain five evidence groups")
    brown_formal_metrics = [
        _metric("Brown综合色素目标数量", int(brown["brown_spot_count"]), "个", "COUNT", "有效分析区域内检出的Brown综合色素目标数量。"),
        _metric("Brown综合色素面积占比", float(brown["brown_spot_area_ratio"]), "%", "PERCENTAGE", "Brown综合色素目标面积占有效分析区域的比例。"),
        _metric("Brown综合色素平均响应", float(brown["mean_brownness"]), "0～1", "INTENSITY_ENGINEERING", "Brown综合色素区域的平均相对响应。"),
        _metric("Brown综合色素P90响应", float(brown["p90_brownness"]), "0～1", "INTENSITY_ENGINEERING", "Brown综合色素响应的第90百分位。"),
    ]
    groups[2]["metrics"] = brown_formal_metrics
    groups[2]["images"] = [_image(brown_image, "Brown综合色素结果")]
    result_images = list(pigment.get("结果图") or [])
    if len(result_images) < 3:
        raise ValueError("formal module 03 lost the Visible/UV/Brown image slots")
    # The concise report intentionally displays one image per module.  Make
    # the promoted Brown result the Clinic-route primary while retaining
    # Visible and UV immediately behind it for the detailed evidence groups.
    pigment["结果图"] = [
        str(brown_image),
        result_images[0],
        result_images[1],
        *result_images[3:],
    ]
    for metric in pigment.get("核心指标") or []:
        if metric.get("name") == "棕色实例数量":
            metric.update(
                value=int(brown["brown_spot_count"]),
                explanation="有效分析区域内检出的Brown综合色素目标数量。",
            )
        elif metric.get("name") in {"棕色实例面积占比", "Brown综合色素面积占比"}:
            metric.update(value=float(brown["brown_spot_area_ratio"]))

    redness = _module(payload, "04")
    red_groups = redness.get("医生结果分组") or []
    if len(red_groups) != 4:
        raise ValueError("formal module 04 must retain four evidence groups")
    red_metrics = [
        _metric("红区特征点数量", int(red["red_feature_count"]), "个", "COUNT", "有效分析区域内检出的红区特征点数量。"),
        _metric("红区特征面积占比", float(red["red_feature_area_ratio"]), "%", "PERCENTAGE", "红区特征面积占有效分析区域的比例。"),
        _metric("平均红度", float(red["mean_redness"]), "0～1", "INTENSITY_ENGINEERING", "有效分析区域的平均相对红度。"),
        _metric("P90红度", float(red["p90_redness"]), "0～1", "INTENSITY_ENGINEERING", "红度响应的第90百分位。"),
    ]
    red_groups[0]["images"] = []
    red_groups[1]["metrics"] = red_metrics
    red_groups[1]["images"] = [_image(red_image, "红区结果")]
    redness["结果图"] = [str(red_image)]
    for metric in redness.get("核心指标") or []:
        if metric.get("name") == "弥漫红区面积占比":
            metric.update(value=float(red["red_area_ratio"]))
        elif metric.get("name") == "P90红度":
            metric.update(value=float(red["p90_redness"]))
    redness["结果摘要"] = re.sub(
        r"弥漫红区覆盖\d+(?:\.\d+)?%",
        f"弥漫红区覆盖{float(red['red_area_ratio']) * 100:.2f}%",
        str(redness.get("结果摘要") or ""),
        count=1,
    )
    return {
        "brown_image_sha256": file_sha256(brown_image),
        "red_image_sha256": file_sha256(red_image),
        "brown_metrics_sha256": file_sha256(measurement["brown_metrics_path"]),
        "red_metrics_sha256": file_sha256(measurement["red_metrics_path"]),
        "lineage_sha256": file_sha256(measurement["lineage_path"]),
        "source_receipt_sha256": file_sha256(measurement["receipt_path"]),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

"""Clinic-only modality provider for the unified twelve-item runtime."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import time
from typing import Any

import cv2
import numpy as np

from src.detection_runtime.capture_manifest import ClinicCaptureInput
from src.detection_runtime.instrument_style import InstrumentStyleRedBrownBaseProvider
from src.detection_runtime.public_metrics import (
    write_added_item_public_metrics,
    write_uv_or_porphyrin_public_metrics,
)
from src.doctor_v2.fast3 import _uv_results, _with_public_visia_boundary
from src.engines.brown_engine import BrownAreaAnalyzer
from src.engines.clinic_vascular_structure_engine import ClinicVascularStructureAnalyzer
from src.engines.rbx_engine import ErythemaAnalyzer
from src.engines.surface_gloss_engine import SurfaceGlossAnalyzer
from src.preprocess.image_preprocessor import ImagePreprocessor, PreprocessResultV2


def _decode(path: Path) -> np.ndarray:
    image = cv2.imdecode(np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint8), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    if image is None:
        raise ValueError(f"cannot decode capture input: {path.name}")
    return image


def _write_image(path: Path, image: np.ndarray) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    suffix = path.suffix.lower()
    params = [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 95] if suffix in {".jpg", ".jpeg"} else [cv2.IMWRITE_PNG_COMPRESSION, 3]
    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(suffix, image, params)
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(f"cannot encode {path.name}")
    encoded.tofile(path)
    return path


def _json(path: Path, value: Any) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _item(
    label: str,
    image: Path,
    metric_json: Path,
    metric_csv: Path,
    v2_csv: Path,
    *,
    additional_images: list[Path] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    item = {
        "项目": label,
        "状态": "success",
        "主结果图": str(image),
        "量化JSON": str(metric_json),
        "量化CSV": str(metric_csv),
        "医学V2CSV": str(v2_csv),
    }
    if additional_images:
        item["附加结果图"] = [str(path) for path in additional_images]
    return item


def _mask_metrics(mask: np.ndarray, denominator: np.ndarray, score: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    support = np.asarray(mask) > 0
    valid = np.asarray(denominator) > 0
    values = np.asarray(score, dtype=np.float32)[support]
    count = max(cv2.connectedComponents(support.astype(np.uint8), 8)[0] - 1, 0)
    return {
        "instance_count": int(count),
        "area_px": int(np.count_nonzero(support)),
        "valid_area_px": int(np.count_nonzero(valid)),
        "area_ratio": round(float(np.count_nonzero(support)) / max(int(np.count_nonzero(valid)), 1), 8),
        "p50_intensity": round(float(np.percentile(values, 50)) if values.size else 0.0, 6),
        "p90_intensity": round(float(np.percentile(values, 90)) if values.size else 0.0, 6),
    }


class ClinicFourLightProvider:
    """Preprocess four M channels once, then run route-specific heads."""

        self.preprocessor = preprocessor or ImagePreprocessor()
        self.style_provider = InstrumentStyleRedBrownBaseProvider()

    def _prepare(
        self, capture: ClinicCaptureInput
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, PreprocessResultV2], dict[str, np.ndarray], dict[str, float]]:
        prepared: dict[str, PreprocessResultV2] = {}
        decoded: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
        timing: dict[str, float] = {}
        for role in ("RGB_M", "PP_M", "CP_M", "365_M"):
            channel = capture.channel(role)
            started = time.perf_counter()
            decoded[role] = _decode(channel.path)
            result = self.preprocessor.preprocess_image(decoded[role])
            if result.analysis_image.shape[:2] != (1024, 1024):
                raise ValueError(f"clinic preprocess escaped 1024 space: {role}")
            prepared[role] = result
            timing[f"preprocess_{role}"] = round(time.perf_counter() - started, 4)
        return prepared, decoded, timing

# DermaVision 十二项红棕显示与量化合同二次纠偏

## 总结

已确认当前问题不是核心算法，而是两处接线错误：

- 红棕链虽然调用了厂家 `core.skin_generate.Enhence_images`，随后却又把厂家底图交给 RBX/Brown 渲染器二次着色，导致最终主图重新变成我们的风格。
- UV、卟啉、油光、血管样、轮廓紧致度使用了临时通用导出器，错误生成中文 JSON 和纵向长表 CSV，没有复用成熟量化合同。

本轮从主目录 `8bfb977` 创建独立修复分支，不直接修改主目录、不运行Word、不改变检测阈值。完成六套结果后先交用户验收，再决定是否合并。

## 关键修改

### 1. 红棕图完全复用已验证的Word链路

直接复用此前Word报告已打通的 r20 仪器风格链，不再设计新底图方案：

- 单RGB路线：`Enhence_images(RGB_M, RGB_M, RGB_M)`。
- 四光源路线：`Enhence_images(CP_M, CP_M, CP_M)`。
- 厂家模块唯一负责生成 `RED_M/BROWN_M/REDNE_M` 像素。
- 我们的红区、棕区检测器只计算Mask、特征点和指标，不得再次改变厂家底图色调、亮度或背景。
- 正式显示图直接以厂家 `RED_M/BROWN_M` 为画布，只叠加VISIA天蓝分区线及对应特征点，目标视觉固定为用户第三张截图和既有r20右侧结果。

每项保留三张图：

- 原始厂家RED/BROWN底图。
- 厂家底图上的完整检测结果。
- 厂家底图上的VISIA特征点实例图。

`REDNE_M`继续作为红色增强辅助图，不生成独立指标。旧RBX/Brown二次伪彩图只允许留在内部调试目录，不进入十二项公开目录和索引。

### 2. 恢复两份CSV的成熟结构

仅修正拆分项和新增项：UV色斑、卟啉、油光、血管样结构、轮廓紧致度。红区、斑点、棕区、纹理、毛孔以及成熟皱纹/痤疮转换器保持不变。

简版CSV：

| 项目 | 固定结构 |
|---|---|
| UV色斑、卟啉 | `总计,额头,左脸颊,右脸颊,鼻部,下巴`，仅一行数量 |
| 油光 | 同一分区结构，两行：油光面积占比、油光区域数量 |
| 血管样结构 | 同一分区结构，两行：目标数量、总长度 |
| 轮廓紧致度 | 一行全面部指标，列出既有8项相对几何量 |

删除UV/卟啉简版CSV中多余的“检测项目”列。

详细医学V2 CSV全部改为成熟宽表：

```text
检测范围,评估状态,有效皮肤面积（像素）,核心-...,辅助-...
```

- 第一行为全面部，后续每行一个实际支持的分区。
- 禁止继续使用“指标名称/检测结果/单位”逐指标纵向长表。
- 轮廓紧致度只有全面部一行，不虚构不存在的分区。
- CSV字段、单位、数值直接从同一结构化结果生成，不重复计算。

### 3. 云端JSON恢复英文合同

新增和拆分项统一使用现有 `medical_v2_schema.to_english_document`，固定顶层字段：

```text
project
metrics_version
scoring_status
imaging_and_units
overall_metrics
region_metrics
left_right_comparison
quality_control
medical_limitations
```

要求：

- JSON键名及状态枚举全部使用既有英文协议。
- 不出现中文键、绝对路径、模型路径、GPU参数、内部类名、audit或reason code。
- JSON、简版CSV和详细CSV从同一个规范化结果对象投影，禁止分别拼装。
- 旧五项Worker字段和现有`purple`四图结构不删除、不改名；新任务只做增量扩展。
- 五字段信封及`meta_data.version="1"`保持不变。

## 验证与交付

先增加格式快照测试，再串行运行：

- consumer：clinic28-25、09、23各仅输入`RGB_M`。
- clinic：clinic28-25、09、23各输入四张M通道。

验收条件：

- 六套均完整输出12项。
- 红棕回执证明实际调用`Enhence_images`，没有读取图库参考结果。
- 红棕主图除天蓝边界和特征标记外，其他像素保持厂家底图；不得出现RBX二次着色。
- 红、棕每项均有底图、检测图、实例图。
- UV和卟啉简版CSV与红棕/毛孔格式一致。
- 五个新增或拆分项的详细CSV均为宽表，JSON全部使用英文键。
- 皱纹、痤疮继续使用成熟公开转换器，无本地路径。
- 图片、JSON、两份CSV和十二项索引数值一致。
- 旧Worker合同零漂移，新字段只增不删。
- 运行定向测试、Worker合同测试、禁止字段扫描及`git diff --check`。
- 记录每套耗时、峰值RSS和输出大小，不运行Word、13例、28套或1000图。

Git分三个检查点保存：

1. 复用r20厂家红棕显示链并移除公开二次着色图。
2. 恢复新增/拆分项的简版CSV、详细CSV和英文JSON。
3. 六套双路线验收、Worker兼容和性能记录。

最终只提交六套统一结果目录和验证回执供用户检查；确认前不合并、不推送、不部署。
</proposed_plan>

from __future__ import annotations

"""Validated vendor RED/BROWN/REDNE base generation for both runtime routes.

This module reuses the exact ``core.skin_generate.Enhence_images`` call and
affine alignment accepted by the medical Word workflow. It does not implement
a second colour renderer and never consumes archived reference images.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
import hashlib
import importlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from typing import Any

import cv2
import numpy as np

from src.preprocess.image_preprocessor import PreprocessResultV2


_VENDOR_OUTPUTS = ("RED_M.jpg", "BROWN_M.jpg", "REDNE_M.jpg")
_VALIDATED_RELATIVE_MODULE_ROOT = Path(
    "内网Worker云端调试_20260805/visia-unified-contour-lzt-0812/"
    "test-output/doctor-v2/vendor-exact-runtime-r16/pyz"
)


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _write_png(path: Path, image: np.ndarray) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".png", image, [cv2.IMWRITE_PNG_COMPRESSION, 3])
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(f"cannot encode vendor aligned base: {path.name}")
    encoded.tofile(path)
    return path


def _resolve_vendor_modules_root(explicit: Path | None) -> Path:
    configured = explicit or (
        Path(os.environ["DERMAVISION_VENDOR_SKIN_MODULES_ROOT"])
        if os.environ.get("DERMAVISION_VENDOR_SKIN_MODULES_ROOT")
        else None
    )
    candidates: list[Path] = []
    if configured is not None:
        candidates.append(configured)
    # The shared venv resolves back to the main checkout, so every worktree
    # consumes the one already validated local vendor-module cache.
    candidates.append(Path(sys.prefix).resolve().parent / _VALIDATED_RELATIVE_MODULE_ROOT)
    candidates.append(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / _VALIDATED_RELATIVE_MODULE_ROOT)
    for candidate in candidates:
        root = candidate.expanduser().resolve()
        if (root / "core" / "skin_generate.pyc").is_file():
            return root
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "validated core.skin_generate module cache is unavailable; set "
        "DERMAVISION_VENDOR_SKIN_MODULES_ROOT"
    )


def _load_vendor_function(modules_root: Path):
    root_text = str(modules_root)
    if root_text not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, root_text)
    module = importlib.import_module("core.skin_generate")
    module_path = Path(module.__file__ or "").resolve()
    if not module_path.is_relative_to(modules_root):
        raise RuntimeError("core.skin_generate was loaded from an unapproved module root")
    function = getattr(module, "Enhence_images", None)
    if not callable(function):
        raise RuntimeError("vendor Enhence_images is unavailable")
    return function


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InstrumentStylePair:
    red: PreprocessResultV2
    brown: PreprocessResultV2
    redne_image: np.ndarray
    red_base_path: Path
    brown_base_path: Path
    redne_base_path: Path
    source_role: str
    renderer_version: str
    provenance: dict[str, Any]


class InstrumentStyleRedBrownBaseProvider:
    """Run the already validated front-only vendor skin-map generator."""

    version = "vendor-core.skin_generate.Enhence_images-front-only-v1"

    def __init__(self, modules_root: Path | None = None) -> None:
        self._configured_modules_root = modules_root
        self.modules_root: Path | None = None
        self._enhance_images = None

    def _ensure_loaded(self) -> None:
        if self._enhance_images is not None and self.modules_root is not None:
            return
        self.modules_root = _resolve_vendor_modules_root(self._configured_modules_root)
        self._enhance_images = _load_vendor_function(self.modules_root)

    @staticmethod
    def _aligned(source: np.ndarray, matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return cv2.warpAffine(
            source,
            matrix,
            (1024, 1024),
            flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
            borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,
            borderValue=(255, 255, 255),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _bound_generated(root: Path, name: str, expected_shape: tuple[int, int]) -> Path:
        resolved_root = root.resolve(strict=True)
        path = (resolved_root / name).resolve(strict=True)
        if not path.is_relative_to(resolved_root) or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError(f"invalid vendor output: {name}")
        image = cv2.imread(str(path), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if image is None or image.shape[:2] != expected_shape:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid vendor output image: {name}")
        return path

    def build(
        self,
        preprocess_result: PreprocessResultV2,
        *,
        source_image: np.ndarray,
        output_root: Path,
        source_role: str,
    ) -> InstrumentStylePair:
        if source_image.ndim != 3 or source_image.shape[2] != 3:
            raise ValueError("vendor skin-map source must be a decoded BGR image")
        self._ensure_loaded()
        assert self.modules_root is not None and self._enhance_images is not None
        generated_root = output_root.resolve()
        generated_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)

        # Word acceptance used the front image in all three positional slots.
        result = self._enhance_images(
            source_image,
            source_image,
            source_image,
            str(generated_root),
            ["red", "brown", "hxs"],
        )
        if not isinstance(result, dict) or result.get("status") != "sucessful!":
            raise RuntimeError(f"vendor Enhence_images failed: {result!r}")

        expected_shape = source_image.shape[:2]
        raw_paths = {
            name: self._bound_generated(generated_root, name, expected_shape)
            for name in _VENDOR_OUTPUTS
        }
        raw_images = {
            name: cv2.imread(str(path), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
            for name, path in raw_paths.items()
        }
        aligned = {
            name: self._aligned(image, preprocess_result.face_transform_matrix)

    @staticmethod
    def _render_brown(
        image: np.ndarray,
        face_render_mask: np.ndarray,
        person_foreground_mask: np.ndarray,
        statistics_mask: np.ndarray,
    ) -> np.ndarray:
        lab = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB).astype(np.float32)
        l_channel = lab[:, :, 0] / 255.0
        a_channel = (lab[:, :, 1] - 128.0) / 127.0
        b_channel = (lab[:, :, 2] - 128.0) / 127.0
        rgb = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
        rgb_sum = np.maximum(np.sum(rgb, axis=2), 1e-5)
        rgb_brown = rgb[:, :, 0] / rgb_sum - rgb[:, :, 2] / rgb_sum

        # 与老版 R-G 直取法对应的棕色素直取证据。背景和五官均不参与
        # 分位数，避免白背景、眼球或嘴唇把棕色动态范围拉坏。
        raw_brown = (
            Config.RENDER_DARK_WEIGHT * (1.0 - l_channel)
            + Config.RENDER_YELLOW_WEIGHT * np.maximum(b_channel, 0.0)
            + Config.RENDER_RED_BROWN_WEIGHT * np.maximum(a_channel, 0.0)
            + Config.RENDER_RGB_BROWN_WEIGHT * np.maximum(rgb_brown, 0.0)
        )
        valid = raw_brown[statistics_mask > 0]
        if valid.size:
            low, high = np.percentile(
                valid,
                [Config.RENDER_PERCENTILE_LOW, Config.RENDER_PERCENTILE_HIGH],
            )
        else:
            low, high = 0.0, 1.0
        high = max(float(high), float(low) + 1e-6)
        global_norm = np.clip((raw_brown - low) / (high - low), 0.0, 1.0)
        # 连续底图只使用每个前景像素自身的棕色色彩证据。五官遮挡 Mask
        # 不得以任何空间形状混入这里，否则 score 域外的 0 会形成眼周、
        # 唇周或鼻孔周围的规则矩形伪影。``statistics_mask`` 仅用于上面的
        # 稳健分位数取样；30px 五官禁区仅用于后续实例点删除。
        brown_norm = global_norm
        brown_norm = np.power(brown_norm, Config.RENDER_GAMMA)

        # 精确复用旧版 15px 高频增强，恢复棕色斑点和细颗粒，而不是把
        # 整张脸平铺成相同棕色。
        brown_blur = cv2.GaussianBlur(
            brown_norm,
            (Config.RENDER_DETAIL_KERNEL, Config.RENDER_DETAIL_KERNEL),
            0,
        )
        brown_sharp = np.clip(
            brown_norm
            + (brown_norm - brown_blur) * Config.RENDER_DETAIL_BOOST,
            0.0,
            1.0,
        )
        density = 1.0 - np.power(
            np.clip(1.0 - brown_sharp, 0.0, 1.0),
            Config.RENDER_DENSITY_CONTRAST,
        )
        canvas = (
            Config.COLOR_BASE[None, None, :] * (1.0 - density[:, :, None])
            + Config.COLOR_BROWN[None, None, :] * density[:, :, None]
        )

        # 旧版 9px 有符号亮度 DoG：暗纹理向深棕推进，亮纹理向浅底推进。
        gray = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
        gray_blur = cv2.GaussianBlur(
            gray,
            (Config.RENDER_STRUCTURE_KERNEL, Config.RENDER_STRUCTURE_KERNEL),
            0,
        )
        canvas += (
            gray - gray_blur
        )[:, :, None] * Config.RENDER_STRUCTURE_BOOST

        face_alpha = cv2.GaussianBlur(
            (face_render_mask > 0).astype(np.float32), (0, 0), sigmaX=1.5, sigmaY=1.5
        )
        foreground_alpha = cv2.GaussianBlur(
            (person_foreground_mask > 0).astype(np.float32), (0, 0), sigmaX=1.5, sigmaY=1.5
        )
        # 保持 fc92752 的棕区颜色、对比度、纹理和 score 完全不变，只把
        # 同一张已生成的伪彩画布扩展到完整人像前景。背景仍为白色；头发、
        # 耳朵和五官不进入统计，也不使用另一套着色公式。
        result = (
            canvas * foreground_alpha[:, :, None]
            + 255.0 * (1.0 - foreground_alpha[:, :, None])
        )
        return np.clip(result, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)

from __future__ import annotations

"""Project accepted red/brown findings onto the untouched vendor canvas."""

import cv2
import numpy as np

from src.engines.brown_engine import Config as BrownConfig
from src.engines.rbx_engine import Config as RedConfig
from src.engines.visia_regions import build_visia_regions, draw_region_boundaries
from src.preprocess.image_preprocessor import PreprocessResultV2


def _regions(preprocessed: PreprocessResultV2):
    return build_visia_regions(
        preprocessed.analysis_image,
        preprocessed.skin_mask,
        preprocessed.landmarks,
        preprocessed.quality_flags,
        include_chin=True,
        mode="full",
    )


def _validate(base: np.ndarray, marker_mask: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    canvas = np.asarray(base)
    marker = np.asarray(marker_mask)
    if canvas.ndim != 3 or canvas.shape[2] != 3:
        raise ValueError("instrument-style public canvas must be BGR")
    if marker.shape[:2] != canvas.shape[:2]:
        raise ValueError("instrument-style marker mask shape mismatch")
    return (marker > 0).astype(np.uint8) * 255


def _with_boundary(preprocessed: PreprocessResultV2, image: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    regions = _regions(preprocessed)
    return draw_region_boundaries(
        image,
        regions.display_regions,
        RedConfig.RED_FEATURE_ZONE_COLOR,
        thickness=RedConfig.RED_FEATURE_ZONE_THICKNESS,
        partial_face=regions.partial_face,
        closed_contour=regions.display_contour,
        separator_contour=regions.display_separator,
    )


def render_vendor_red_result(
    preprocessed: PreprocessResultV2,
    vendor_base: np.ndarray,
    marker_mask: np.ndarray,
    *,
    include_boundary: bool,
) -> np.ndarray:
    marker = _validate(vendor_base, marker_mask)
    output = np.asarray(vendor_base).copy()
    output[marker > 0] = RedConfig.RED_FEATURE_MARKER_COLOR
    return _with_boundary(preprocessed, output) if include_boundary else output


def render_vendor_brown_result(
    preprocessed: PreprocessResultV2,
    vendor_base: np.ndarray,
    instance_mask: np.ndarray,
    *,
    include_boundary: bool,
) -> np.ndarray:
    marker = _validate(vendor_base, instance_mask)
    output = np.asarray(vendor_base).copy()
    pixels = marker > 0
    if np.any(pixels):
        colour = np.asarray(BrownConfig.INSTANCE_COLOR, dtype=np.float32)
        output[pixels] = np.clip(
            0.15 * output[pixels].astype(np.float32) + 0.85 * colour,
            0,
            255,
        ).astype(np.uint8)
        contours, _ = cv2.findContours(
            marker,
            cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL,
            cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE,
        )
        cv2.drawContours(
            output,
            contours,
            -1,
            BrownConfig.INSTANCE_COLOR,
            1,
            lineType=cv2.LINE_AA,
        )
    return _with_boundary(preprocessed, output) if include_boundary else output


__all__ = ["render_vendor_brown_result", "render_vendor_red_result"]

from __future__ import annotations

"""Public CSV/JSON adapters for route-specific and newly added detections."""

import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


REGION_ORDER = ("forehead", "left_cheek", "right_cheek", "nose", "chin")
REGION_LABELS = {
    "forehead": "额头",
    "left_cheek": "左脸颊",
    "right_cheek": "右脸颊",
    "nose": "鼻部",

    "left_inner_cheek": "左内侧面颊",

    "left_outer_cheek": "左外侧面颊",
    "right_outer_cheek": "右外侧面颊",
    "left_periocular": "左眼周",
    "right_periocular": "右眼周",
    "left_zygoma": "左颧部",
    "right_zygoma": "右颧部",
    "left_jaw": "左下颌",
    "right_jaw": "右下颌",
    "nose_alar_nasal_side": "鼻翼及鼻旁",
}


def _write_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return path


def _write_csv(path: Path, header: tuple[str, ...], rows: list[tuple[Any, ...]]) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.writer(handle)
        writer.writerow(header)
        writer.writerows(rows)
    return path


def _metric(value: Any, unit: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"数值": value, "单位": unit}


def write_uv_or_porphyrin_public_metrics(
    *,
    item_id: str,
    raw: dict[str, Any],
    json_path: Path,
    csv_path: Path,
    v2_path: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path]:
    if item_id not in {"uv_spots", "porphyrin"}:
        raise ValueError(item_id)
    label = "UV色斑" if item_id == "uv_spots" else "卟啉"
    version = "UV365Spots-V1" if item_id == "uv_spots" else "FluorescencePorphyrin-Real365-HighRecall-V1"
    regions = raw.get("regions") or {}
    region_document: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in regions.items():
        region_document[str(value.get("label") or REGION_LABELS.get(key, key))] = {
            "目标数量": _metric(int(value.get("count") or 0), "个"),
            "目标面积": _metric(int(value.get("area") or 0), "像素"),
            "面积占比": _metric(float(value.get("area_ratio") or 0.0), "比例"),
            "平均响应": _metric(float(value.get("mean_score") or 0.0), "0～1"),
        }
    document = {
        "检测项目": label,
        "指标版本": version,
        "评估状态": "可评估",
        "总体指标": {
            "目标数量": _metric(int(raw.get("instance_count") or 0), "个"),
            "目标面积": _metric(int(raw.get("area_px") or 0), "像素"),
            "有效分析面积": _metric(int(raw.get("valid_area_px") or 0), "像素"),
            "目标面积占比": _metric(float(raw.get("area_ratio") or 0.0), "比例"),
            "P50强度": _metric(float(raw.get("p50_intensity") or 0.0), "0～1"),
            "P90强度": _metric(float(raw.get("p90_intensity") or 0.0), "0～1"),
        },
        "分区指标": region_document,
        "左右比较": {},
        "能力边界": (
            ["仅表示真实365图像中的二维UV吸收增强色斑候选，不等同于临床诊断。"]
            if item_id == "uv_spots"
            else ["仅表示真实365图像中的卟啉荧光候选，不直接等同于皮脂量或痤疮诊断。"]
        ),
    }
    _write_json(json_path, document)
    counts = [int((regions.get(key) or {}).get("count") or 0) for key in REGION_ORDER]
    _write_csv(
        csv_path,
        ("检测项目", "总计", "额头", "左脸颊", "右脸颊", "鼻部", "下巴"),
        [(label, int(raw.get("instance_count") or 0), *counts)],
    )
    long_rows: list[tuple[Any, ...]] = []
    for scope, metrics in (("全面部", document["总体指标"]), *region_document.items()):

            long_rows.append((label, scope, "可评估", name, metric_value["数值"], metric_value["单位"]))
    _write_csv(
        v2_path,
        ("检测项目", "检测范围", "评估状态", "指标名称", "检测结果", "单位"),
        long_rows,
    )

def _translate_keys(value: Any, mapping: dict[str, str]) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {
            mapping.get(str(key), str(key)): _translate_keys(child, mapping)
            for key, child in value.items()
        }
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [_translate_keys(child, mapping) for child in value]
    return value


def _assert_no_chinese_keys(value: Any, path: str = "$") -> None:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, child in value.items():
            name = str(key)
            if any("\u4e00" <= character <= "\u9fff" for character in name):
                raise ValueError(f"医学 V2 JSON 存在未映射中文字段: {path}.{name}")
            _assert_no_chinese_keys(child, f"{path}.{name}")
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, child in enumerate(value):
            _assert_no_chinese_keys(child, f"{path}[{index}]")

    support = np.asarray(mask) > 0

    count = max(cv2.connectedComponents(support.astype(np.uint8), 8)[0] - 1, 0)
    return {
        "instance_count": int(count),
        "area_px": int(np.count_nonzero(support)),

# AGENTS.md - dermavision

## 信封格式（worker 返回）

dermavision worker 的 `analyze_image` 任务必须返回统一信封格式。信封包含 5 个字段：

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `record_id` | str | 任务追踪 ID，同时用作 OSS 结果路径组件。后端 AlgorithmEnvelope 接受此字段但不参与核心校验 |
| `status` | str | 任务状态：`"success"` / `"failed"`。后端 `_check_group` 检查此字段，failed 会直接报错 |
| `meta_data` | dict | 算法元数据：`{"name": <算法名>, "version": "1"}`。version 写死 `"1"`，对应后端 AlgorithmRegistry 注册的 v1 实现器 |
| `raw_result` | dict | 算法原始结果（OSS key 形式的图片路径 + 量化指标 + 质量信息）。后端读取时调 `to_response` 转换为前端格式 |
| `debug_info` | dict | 调试信息（CSV 报告路径、计时、执行模式）。不直接给前端，由 `to_response` 提取需要的字段 |

### 信封结构示例

```json
{
  "record_id": "6a61770e3423989c53a05d63",
  "status": "success",
  "meta_data": {
    "name": "redness",
    "version": "1"
  },
  "raw_result": {
    "overlay": "dermavision/v1/6a61770e.../03_RBX红区结果图.jpg",
    "metrics": { ... },
    "quality_score": 74.89,
    "quality_status": "WARNING",
    "quality_flags": ["low_contrast"]
  },
  "debug_info": {
    "report_csv": "dermavision/v1/6a61770e.../redness_report.csv",
    "timing_seconds": { "download": 0.5, "pipeline": 3.2, "upload": 0.3 },
    "execution_mode": "single_algorithm"
  }
}
```

### raw_result 字段（各算法差异）

| 算法 | 共有字段 | 特有字段 |
|------|----------|----------|
| redness | overlay, metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | red_areas_overlay |
| spots | overlay, metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | - |
| brown | overlay, metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | brown_spots_overlay |
| texture | overlay, metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | - |
| pores | overlay, metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | - |
| purple | metrics, quality_score, quality_status, quality_flags | uv_base, uv_spots_overlay, fluorescence_base, porphyrin_overlay |

- `overlay`: OSS key（结果图），后端 `to_response` 转预签名 URL
- `metrics`: 量化指标 dict，redness/spots 为完整英文 dict 透传，brown/texture/pores 为精简中文 dict
- `quality_score`/`quality_status`/`quality_flags`: 图片质量信息
- `purple` 为独立新增算法，正式返回四张图：UV底图、UV色斑实例图、
  荧光UV底图和紫质实例图；现有五项字段保持不变。

### version 写死 "1"

`meta_data.version` 写死 `"1"`，不再从环境变量 `settings.algorithm_version` 读取。后端 AlgorithmRegistry 按 `(name, "1")` 注册 v1 实现器，version 不匹配会导致 `get_version` 找不到、回退 v0（旧格式透传）。

### 多算法兼容模式

def _image(path: Path, caption: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"path": str(path), "caption": caption}


def _read_image(path: Path) -> np.ndarray:
    image = cv2.imdecode(np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint8), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    if image is None:
        raise ValueError(f"unable to decode report image: {path}")
    if image.shape[:2] != (1024, 1024):
        raise ValueError(
            f"report image must be 1024x1024: {path}: "
            f"{image.shape[1]}x{image.shape[0]}"
        )
    return image


def _write_image(path: Path, image: np.ndarray) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", image, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 95])
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(f"unable to encode report image: {path}")
    encoded.tofile(path)
    return path


def _fixed_input(alias: str, role: str) -> Path:
    manifest_path = FIXED_INPUT_ROOT / "input_manifest.json"
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    matches = [
        row for row in manifest["inputs"]
        if row["capture_alias"] == alias and row["role"] == role
    ]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"fixed input is not unique: {alias}/{role}")
    row = matches[0]
    path = (FIXED_INPUT_ROOT / row["relative_path"]).resolve(strict=True)
    if not path.is_relative_to(FIXED_INPUT_ROOT.resolve(strict=True)) or path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError(f"fixed input escaped root: {row['relative_path']}")
    if path.stat().st_size != row["size_bytes"] or file_sha256(path) != row["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError(f"fixed input drifted: {alias}/{role}")
    return path


def _prepare_vascular_formal_image(
    cp_input: Path,
    output_path: Path,
) -> Path:
    """Render the CP image through the same public boundary chain as VISIA."""

    source = cv2.imdecode(np.fromfile(cp_input, dtype=np.uint8), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    if source is None:
        raise ValueError(f"unable to decode fixed CP input: {cp_input}")
    preprocessed = ImagePreprocessor().preprocess_image(source)
    regions = build_visia_regions(
        preprocessed.analysis_image,
        preprocessed.skin_mask,
        preprocessed.landmarks,
        preprocessed.quality_flags,
        mode="full",
    )
    rendered = draw_region_boundaries(
        preprocessed.analysis_image,
        regions.display_regions,
        partial_face=regions.partial_face,
        landmarks=preprocessed.landmarks,
        closed_contour=regions.display_contour,
        separator_contour=regions.display_separator,
    )
    return _write_image(output_path, rendered)


def _load_vascular_v3(root: Path, alias: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Load one hash-bound 05-only result without rerunning any algorithm."""

    run_root = root.resolve(strict=True)
    manifest_path = run_root / "run_manifest.json"
    receipt_path = run_root / "validation_receipt.json"
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if receipt.get("status") != "PASS" or receipt.get("run_manifest_sha256") != file_sha256(manifest_path):
        raise ValueError("vascular V3 run receipt is not valid")
    rows = [row for row in manifest.get("captures", []) if row.get("capture_alias") == alias]
    if len(rows) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"vascular V3 result is not unique: {alias}")
    row = rows[0]
    resolved: dict[str, Path] = {}
    for key in ("formal_overlay", "metrics", "instances", "vascular_mask", "skeleton_mask", "branch_mask"):
        artifact = row["artifacts"][key]
        path = (run_root / artifact["relative_path"]).resolve(strict=True)
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_relative_to(run_root):
            raise ValueError(f"vascular V3 artifact escaped root: {key}")
        if path.stat().st_size != artifact["size_bytes"] or file_sha256(path) != artifact["sha256"]:

def _decode(path: Path) -> np.ndarray:
    image = cv2.imdecode(np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint8), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    if image is None:
        raise ValueError(f"cannot decode capture input: {path.name}")
    return image


def _write_image(path: Path, image: np.ndarray) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    suffix = path.suffix.lower()
    params = [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 95] if suffix in {".jpg", ".jpeg"} else [cv2.IMWRITE_PNG_COMPRESSION, 3]
    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(suffix, image, params)
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(f"cannot encode {path.name}")
    encoded.tofile(path)
    return path


def _json(path: Path, value: Any) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _item(
    label: str,
    image: Path,
    metric_json: Path,
    metric_csv: Path,
    v2_csv: Path,
    *,
    additional_images: list[Path] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    item = {
        "项目": label,
        "状态": "success",
        "主结果图": str(image),
        "量化JSON": str(metric_json),
        "量化CSV": str(metric_csv),
        "医学V2CSV": str(v2_csv),
    }
    if additional_images:
        item["附加结果图"] = [str(path) for path in additional_images]
    return item


def _mask_metrics(mask: np.ndarray, denominator: np.ndarray, score: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    support = np.asarray(mask) > 0
    valid = np.asarray(denominator) > 0
    values = np.asarray(score, dtype=np.float32)[support]
    count = max(cv2.connectedComponents(support.astype(np.uint8), 8)[0] - 1, 0)
    return {
        "instance_count": int(count),
        "area_px": int(np.count_nonzero(support)),
        "valid_area_px": int(np.count_nonzero(valid)),
        "area_ratio": round(float(np.count_nonzero(support)) / max(int(np.count_nonzero(valid)), 1), 8),
        "p50_intensity": round(float(np.percentile(values, 50)) if values.size else 0.0, 6),
        "p90_intensity": round(float(np.percentile(values, 90)) if values.size else 0.0, 6),
    }

DERMAVISION_CONSUMER_ALGORITHMS = [

def _scalar_metrics(value: Any, prefix: str = "") -> dict[str, float]:
    output: dict[str, float] = {}
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return output
    for key, item in value.items():
        name = f"{prefix}.{key}" if prefix else str(key)
        if isinstance(item, (int, float)) and not isinstance(item, bool):
            output[name] = float(item)
        elif isinstance(item, dict):
            output.update(_scalar_metrics(item, name))
    return output


def _consumer_red_brown_receipt(responses: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    derma = responses.get("dermavision") or {}
    result = (derma.get("result") or {}).get("results") or {}
    receipt = result.get("red_brown_provider_receipt")
    return dict(receipt) if isinstance(receipt, dict) else None


class TwelveAnalysisOrchestrator(NineAnalysisOrchestrator):
    """Consumer RGB runtime: established nine results plus three additions."""

    def _request_algorithms(self, service_name: str) -> list[str] | None:
        if service_name == "dermavision":
            return list(DERMAVISION_CONSUMER_ALGORITHMS)
        return None

    def _canonical_items(self, responses: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
        items = super()._canonical_items(responses)
        derma = responses.get("dermavision", {})
        result = derma.get("result", {}).get("results", {}) if derma.get("status") == "success" else {}
        medical = derma.get("result", {}).get("medical_v2_results", {})
        for key, label in (
            ("surface_gloss", "油光"),
            ("vascular", "血管样结构"),
            ("contour_firmness", "轮廓紧致度"),
        ):
            overlay = result.get(key)
            item = {"项目": label, "状态": "failed"}
            if overlay and Path(overlay).is_file():
                item.update({
                    "状态": "success",
                    "主结果图": overlay,
                    "量化JSON": result.get(f"{key}_metrics"),
                    "量化CSV": result.get(f"{key}_report"),
                    "医学V2CSV": (medical.get(key) or {}).get("csv"),
                })
            items[key] = item
        return items

    def _write_indexes(
        self,
        sample_root: Path,
        image_path: Path,
        responses: dict[str, Any],
        wall_seconds: float,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        items = self._canonical_items(responses)
        return self._write_canonical_indexes(
            sample_root=sample_root,
            image_path=image_path,
            items=items,
            responses=responses,
            wall_seconds=wall_seconds,
            route="consumer_rgb",
            input_images={"RGB_M": str(image_path)},
        )

    def _write_canonical_indexes(

        expected = tuple(item.item_id for item in TWELVE_DETECTION_ITEMS)

        (sample_root / "scoring_features.json").write_text(

                indent=2,

        )
        with (sample_root / "twelve_metrics.csv").open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
            writer = csv.writer(handle)
            writer.writerow(("检测项目", "状态", "主结果图", "量化JSON", "量化CSV"))
            for item in items.values():
                writer.writerow((item["项目"], item["状态"], item.get("主结果图", ""), item.get("量化JSON", ""), item.get("量化CSV", "")))
        timing = {
            "运行ID": self.run_id,
            "路线": route,
            "图片": str(image_path),

            "整次墙钟时间秒": round(wall_seconds, 4),
            "服务": {
                key: {
                    "状态": value.get("status"),
                    "总耗时秒": value.get("seconds"),
                    "算法耗时": value.get("result", {}).get("metadata", {}).get("timing_seconds"),
                    "GPU": value.get("gpu_after"),
                }
                for key, value in responses.items()
            },
        }
        (sample_root / "timing.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(json_safe(timing), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        with (sample_root / "timing.csv").open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:

            for key, value in responses.items():

            writer.writerow(("parallel_wall", status, round(wall_seconds, 4), ""))
        return manifest

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Clinic four-light vascular-like linear-structure detector.

CP is the only measurement image.  RED is a CP-derived proposal/display image,
RGB is an optional visibility check, and PP is used only to reject surface
lines.  The result is an engineering observation, not a vessel diagnosis.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import cv2
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
from skimage.filters import frangi
from skimage.morphology import remove_small_objects, skeletonize

from src.engines.vascular_structure_engine import (
    LEFT_EYE,
    LEFT_EYEBROW,
    LIPS,
    RIGHT_EYE,
    RIGHT_EYEBROW,
    VascularStructureAnalyzer,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ClinicVascularResult:
    face_mask: np.ndarray
    exclusion_mask: np.ndarray
    valid_mask: np.ndarray
    hemoglobin_response: np.ndarray
    vesselness: np.ndarray
    vascular_mask: np.ndarray
    skeleton_mask: np.ndarray
    branch_mask: np.ndarray
    rgb_visibility_mask: np.ndarray | None
    overlay: np.ndarray
    metrics: dict[str, Any]
    instances: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]


class ClinicVascularStructureAnalyzer:
    """VascularStructure-V3-Clinic, isolated from the single-RGB V2.1 path."""

    ALGORITHM = "VascularStructure-V3-Clinic"
    ANALYSIS_SPACE = "aligned_1024_cp"

    def detect(
        self,
        cp: Any,
        *,
        rgb: Any | None = None,
        pp: Any | None = None,
        red_display: np.ndarray | None = None,
    ) -> ClinicVascularResult:
        image = np.asarray(cp.analysis_image)
        if image.shape[:2] != (1024, 1024):
            raise ValueError("Clinic vascular input must use aligned 1024 CP")
        face = self._face_mask(cp)
        exclusion = self._clinic_exclusion(image, face, cp)
        valid = cv2.bitwise_and(face, cv2.bitwise_not(exclusion))
        valid = self._erode(valid, 3)
        valid_pixels = int(np.count_nonzero(valid))
        face_pixels = int(np.count_nonzero(face))
        if valid_pixels < max(20_000, int(face_pixels * 0.25)):
            return self._empty(
                image,
                face,
                exclusion,
                valid,
                red_display,
                "INSUFFICIENT_GEOMETRIC_FACE_DOMAIN",
            )

        cp_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
        r, g, b = (cp_rgb[:, :, index] for index in range(3))
        eps = 1.0 / 255.0
        ei1 = np.log((r + eps) / (g + eps))
        ei2 = np.log((np.sqrt(np.maximum(r * b, 0.0)) + eps) / (g + eps))
        local1 = np.maximum(ei1 - gaussian_filter(ei1, 5.0), 0.0)
        local2 = np.maximum(ei2 - gaussian_filter(ei2, 5.0), 0.0)
        broad1 = np.maximum(ei1 - gaussian_filter(ei1, 11.0), 0.0)
        hemoglobin = np.clip(
            0.45 * self._robust_z(local1, valid)
            + 0.30 * self._robust_z(local2, valid)
            + 0.25 * self._robust_z(broad1, valid),
            0.0,
            8.0,
        ).astype(np.float32)
        hemoglobin[valid == 0] = 0.0

        cp_unit = self._robust_unit(hemoglobin, valid, 15.0, 99.5)
        cp_line = frangi(cp_unit, sigmas=(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), black_ridges=False)
        cp_line = np.nan_to_num(cp_line, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0).astype(np.float32)
        cp_line = self._robust_unit(cp_line, valid, 20.0, 99.8)

        red_aligned = self._aligned_optional(red_display, image.shape)
        if red_aligned is not None:
            red_gray = cv2.cvtColor(red_aligned, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
            red_dark = np.maximum(gaussian_filter(red_gray, 5.0) - red_gray, 0.0)
            red_line = frangi(
                self._robust_unit(red_dark, valid, 35.0, 99.7),
                sigmas=(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
                black_ridges=False,
            )
            red_line = self._robust_unit(np.nan_to_num(red_line).astype(np.float32), valid, 25.0, 99.8)
        else:
            red_line = np.zeros_like(cp_line)

        vesselness = np.clip(0.72 * cp_line + 0.28 * red_line, 0.0, 1.0).astype(np.float32)
        values = vesselness[valid > 0]
        line_threshold = max(float(np.percentile(values, 94.0)), 0.08)

        # Local colour-drop support rejects achromatic dark creases and hair.
        local_r = gaussian_filter(r, 4.0) - r
        local_g = gaussian_filter(g, 4.0) - g
        local_b = gaussian_filter(b, 4.0) - b
        colour_drop = (local_g + local_b) - 1.15 * local_r
        colour_z = self._robust_z(np.maximum(colour_drop, 0.0), valid)
        colour_support = (colour_z >= 0.55) | (hemoglobin >= 1.45)

        surface_reject = np.zeros_like(valid, dtype=bool)
        if pp is not None and np.asarray(pp.analysis_image).shape[:2] == image.shape[:2]:
            pp_gray = cv2.cvtColor(pp.analysis_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
            pp_dark = np.maximum(gaussian_filter(pp_gray, 3.0) - pp_gray, 0.0)
            pp_z = self._robust_z(pp_dark, valid)
            surface_reject = (pp_z >= 2.2) & (hemoglobin < 1.35)
            # This wider band is only where PP may classify a line as a
            # surface eyelid/eyelash structure; it does not remove the band
            # from the CP measurement domain.  The anatomical exclusion below
            # remains the required 3px.
            eye_zone = self._landmark_zone(cp.landmarks, image.shape[:2], (LEFT_EYE, RIGHT_EYE), 20)
            # Eyelashes and eyelid folds are unambiguously surface structures:
            # in their narrow search band PP is allowed to veto them even when
            # CP colour residual is high.  The geometric exclusion itself stays
            # at 3px, so the surrounding periocular skin remains measurable.
            surface_reject |= (pp_z >= 1.0) & (eye_zone > 0)

        candidate = (
            (vesselness >= line_threshold)
            & (hemoglobin >= 1.0)
            & colour_support
            & (~surface_reject)
            & (valid > 0)
        )
        # Closed eyelids make the lid fold and eyelashes look like strong
        # vessels in CP/RED.  Keep the general geometric domain at the required
        # 3px margin, but fail closed in this dedicated presentation guard so
        # surface eyelid structures cannot be promoted as vessels.  Periocular
        # skin outside the narrow closed-eye band remains measurable.
        eyelash_guard = self._landmark_zone(cp.landmarks, image.shape[:2], (LEFT_EYE, RIGHT_EYE), 45)
        candidate &= eyelash_guard == 0
        candidate = remove_small_objects(candidate, min_size=4)
        candidate_u8 = candidate.astype(np.uint8) * 255
        face_width = self._face_width(face)
        mask, instances = self._filter_components(
            candidate_u8,
            hemoglobin,
            vesselness,
            cp_line,
            red_line,
            valid,
            face_width,
        )
        mask = cv2.bitwise_and(mask, valid)
        skeleton = skeletonize(mask > 0).astype(np.uint8) * 255
        branch = self._qualified_branch_points(mask, skeleton)

        rgb_visibility: np.ndarray | None = None
        rgb_support_ratio: float | None = None
        if rgb is not None and np.asarray(rgb.analysis_image).shape[:2] == image.shape[:2]:
            rgb_bgr = np.asarray(rgb.analysis_image)
            lab_a = cv2.cvtColor(rgb_bgr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)[:, :, 1].astype(np.float32)
            local = np.maximum(lab_a - gaussian_filter(lab_a, 7.0), 0.0)
            visible = self._robust_z(local, valid) >= 0.7
            rgb_visibility = ((skeleton > 0) & visible).astype(np.uint8) * 255
            rgb_support_ratio = float(np.count_nonzero(rgb_visibility) / max(np.count_nonzero(skeleton), 1))

        metrics = self._metrics(
            face,
            exclusion,
            valid,
            mask,
            skeleton,
            branch,
            hemoglobin,
            instances,
            rgb_support_ratio,
        )
        base = red_aligned if red_aligned is not None else image
        overlay = self.render_overlay(base, skeleton, branch)
        return ClinicVascularResult(
            face_mask=face,
            exclusion_mask=exclusion,
            valid_mask=valid,
            hemoglobin_response=hemoglobin,
            vesselness=vesselness,
            vascular_mask=mask,
            skeleton_mask=skeleton,
            branch_mask=branch,
            rgb_visibility_mask=rgb_visibility,
            overlay=overlay,
            metrics=metrics,
            instances=tuple(instances),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def render_overlay(base: np.ndarray, skeleton: np.ndarray, branch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        output = np.asarray(base).copy()
        line = cv2.dilate((skeleton > 0).astype(np.uint8), np.ones((2, 2), np.uint8)) > 0
        # A deeper orange remains visible on the pale RED display without the
        # unrelated VISIA region frame competing with the actual findings.
        output[line] = (0, 105, 205)  # deep orange, BGR
        count, _, _, centres = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats((branch > 0).astype(np.uint8), 8)
        for index in range(1, count):
            x, y = np.rint(centres[index]).astype(int)
            cv2.circle(output, (int(x), int(y)), 3, (15, 20, 170), -1, cv2.LINE_AA)
        return output

    def _face_mask(self, cp: Any) -> np.ndarray:
        debug = getattr(cp, "_debug_masks", {}) or {}
        for key in ("display_face_mask", "face_geometry_mask"):
            value = debug.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, np.ndarray) and np.count_nonzero(value):
                return self._binary(value)
        return VascularStructureAnalyzer._recover_outer_face_from_skin(cp.skin_mask)

    @staticmethod
    def _landmark_zone(
        points: np.ndarray,
        shape: tuple[int, int],
        groups: tuple[list[int], ...],
        radius: int,
    ) -> np.ndarray:
        zone = np.zeros(shape, np.uint8)
        points = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float32)
        for indices in groups:
            feature = np.zeros(shape, np.uint8)
            VascularStructureAnalyzer._fill_landmark_hull(feature, points, indices)
            kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (2 * radius + 1, 2 * radius + 1))
            zone = cv2.bitwise_or(zone, cv2.dilate(feature, kernel))
        return zone
    line_pixels = cv2.dilate((mask > 0).astype(np.uint8), np.ones((2, 2), np.uint8)) > 0
    if np.count_nonzero(line_pixels) == 0:
        raise ValueError("dry-line overlay contains no detectable line pixels")
    image[line_pixels] = WRINKLE_GREEN_BGR
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(
        (support > 0).astype(np.uint8) * 255,
        cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL,
        cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE,
    )
    if len(contours) != 2:
        raise ValueError(f"dry-line support must contain two eye regions: {support_path}")
    cv2.drawContours(image, contours, -1, VISIA_BOUNDARY_COLOR, 3, cv2.LINE_AA)
    return _write_image(output_path, image)


def _prepare_unified_boundary_image(
    source: Path,
    modality_input: Path,
    output_path: Path,
) -> Path:
    """Add the public VISIA boundary chain without changing source findings."""

    image = _read_image(source)
    modality = cv2.imdecode(
        np.fromfile(modality_input, dtype=np.uint8),
        cv2.IMREAD_COLOR,
    )
    if modality is None:

    preprocessed = ImagePreprocessor().preprocess_image(modality)
    regions = build_visia_regions(

        landmarks=preprocessed.landmarks,

        separator_contour=regions.display_separator,
    )
    return _write_image(output_path, rendered)

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import io
import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

import run


class NineBatchRunTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_input_and_output_paths_are_explicit_and_output_alias_is_supported(self) -> None:
        parser = run.build_parser()
        with contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
                parser.parse_args([])
        args = parser.parse_args(["--input-dir", "/input", "--output-dir", "/output"])
        self.assertEqual(args.input_dir, Path("/input"))
        self.assertEqual(args.output_dir, Path("/output"))
        alias_args = parser.parse_args(["--input-dir", "/input", "--output", "/legacy"])
        self.assertEqual(alias_args.output_dir, Path("/legacy"))
        self.assertFalse(args.precount)
        self.assertEqual(args.output_profile, "review")
        self.assertIsNone(args.runtime_dir)

    def test_medical_report_is_rejected_in_scoring_only_mode(self) -> None:
        with contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
                run.main([
                    "--input-dir", "/input",
                    "--output-dir", "/output",
                    "--output-profile", "scoring",
                    "--generate-medical-report",
                ])

    def test_runtime_cleanup_removes_only_its_empty_job_directories(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            temporary_root = Path(temporary)
            runtime_root = temporary_root / "runtime" / "job" / "worker"
            run_root = runtime_root / "run-id"
            run_root.mkdir(parents=True)
            (run_root / "debug.txt").write_text("temporary", encoding="utf-8")
            run.remove_runtime_tree(run_root, runtime_root)
            self.assertFalse(run_root.exists())
            self.assertFalse(runtime_root.exists())
            self.assertFalse((temporary_root / "runtime" / "job").exists())
            # The shared runtime root is intentionally not removed.
            self.assertTrue((temporary_root / "runtime").exists())

    def test_batch_statistics_keeps_only_aggregates(self) -> None:
        statistics = run.BatchStatistics()
        statistics.add({"status": "success", "seconds": 2.0})
        statistics.add({"status": "claimed_elsewhere", "seconds": 0.1})
        statistics.add({
            "status": "partial_success",
            "seconds": 4.0,
            "failure_category": "input_quality_reject",
        })
        self.assertEqual(statistics.processed, 3)
        self.assertEqual(statistics.duration_count, 2)
        self.assertEqual(statistics.duration_total, 6.0)
        self.assertEqual(statistics.statuses["partial_success"], 1)

            images = sorted(
                run.iter_images(
                    root,
                    recursive=True,
                    patterns=("*.jpg", "nested/*.png"),
                    excluded_root=root / "output",
                ),
                key=lambda p: p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                [path.relative_to(root).as_posix() for path in images],
                ["a.jpg", "nested/b.png"],
            )

    def test_duplicate_stems_receive_stable_unique_ids(self) -> None:
        from collections import Counter

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            (root / "a").mkdir()
            (root / "b").mkdir()
            first = root / "a" / "same.jpg"
            second = root / "b" / "same.png"
            first.write_bytes(b"1")

            stem_counts: Counter[str] = Counter({"same": 2})

            self.assertNotEqual(id_first, id_second)

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:

import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
from typing import Any


_WINDOWS_PATH = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]:[\\/]")
_FORBIDDEN_KEYS = {
    "audit",
    "reason_code",
    "reason_codes",
    "weights",
    "output_dir",
    "device",
    "gpu",
    "model_path",
    "input_path",
    "source_path",
}


def _walk(value: Any, location: str, errors: list[str]) -> None:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, child in value.items():
            if str(key).lower() in _FORBIDDEN_KEYS:
                errors.append(f"{location}: forbidden public key {key}")
            _walk(child, f"{location}.{key}", errors)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, child in enumerate(value):
            _walk(child, f"{location}[{index}]", errors)
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        if "/home/" in value or "/tmp/" in value or _WINDOWS_PATH.search(value):
            errors.append(f"{location}: leaked absolute path")
        if value.endswith("Analyzer") or ".Analyzer" in value:
            errors.append(f"{location}: leaked internal class name")


def validate_public_delivery(root: Path) -> None:
    errors: list[str] = []
    index_path = root / "十二项检测结果索引.json"
    index = json.loads(index_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    items = index.get("十二项结果") or {}
    if len(items) != 12:
        errors.append("twelve item index is incomplete")
    for item_id, item in items.items():
        image_fields = [item.get("主结果图"), *(item.get("附加结果图") or [])]
        for relative in image_fields:
            if not relative or not (root / relative).is_file():
                errors.append(f"{item_id}: missing indexed image {relative}")
        for key in ("量化JSON", "量化CSV", "医学V2CSV"):
            relative = item.get(key)
            if not relative or not (root / relative).is_file():
                errors.append(f"{item_id}: missing {key}")
    for item_id in ("redness", "brown"):
        item = items.get(item_id) or {}
        if 1 + len(item.get("附加结果图") or []) < 3:
            errors.append(f"{item_id}: expected base, overall and instance images")
    for item_id in ("uv_spots", "porphyrin"):
        item = items.get(item_id) or {}
        if 1 + len(item.get("附加结果图") or []) < 2:
            errors.append(f"{item_id}: expected base and result images")

    for path in root.rglob("*.json"):
        try:
            payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"{path.relative_to(root)}: invalid JSON: {exc}")
            continue
        _walk(payload, path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), errors)
    for path in root.rglob("*.csv"):
        with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
            rows = list(csv.reader(handle))
        if not rows or not rows[0]:
            errors.append(f"{path.relative_to(root)}: empty CSV")
        for row in rows:
            for value in row:
                if "/home/" in value or "/tmp/" in value or _WINDOWS_PATH.search(value):
                    errors.append(f"{path.relative_to(root)}: leaked absolute path")
    if errors:
        raise ValueError("public delivery contract failed:\n" + "\n".join(errors))

class DoctorV2DualRouteRunner:
    """Materialize a three-report delivery from accepted upstream results."""

    def run(self, request: DoctorV2RunRequest) -> DoctorV2RunResult:
        if request.route not in {"consumer_rgb", "clinic_four_light"}:
            raise ValueError("route must be explicitly consumer_rgb or clinic_four_light")
        if set(request.formal_artifacts) != _FORMAL_KEYS:
            raise ValueError("formal artifact set must contain the frozen four baseline roles")
        if request.output_root.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(request.output_root)
        if request.route == "consumer_rgb" and (
            request.clinic_modality_root is not None
            or request.clinic_modality_fallback_root is not None
        ):
            raise ValueError("consumer_rgb forbids PP/CP/365 modality input")
        if request.route == "clinic_four_light" and request.clinic_modality_root is None:
            raise ValueError("clinic_four_light requires a signed modality fixture")
        _, current_code_state = dual_route_code_state()
        if request.code_state_sha256 != current_code_state:
            raise ValueError("dual-route code state changed before execution")

        output = request.output_root
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        staged_nine = stage_nine_review_export(
            request.nine_review_root,
            output / "evidence" / "nine_results",
        )
        projections = stage_formal_wrinkle_projection_artifacts(
            request.formal_artifacts["structured_json"],
            output / "evidence" / "formal_wrinkle_regions",
            snapshot_root=output,
        )
        nine = build_nine_result_bundle(
            staged_nine,
            snapshot_root=output,
            capture_alias=request.capture_alias,
            route=request.route,
            code_state_sha256=request.code_state_sha256,
            doctor11_projection_artifacts=projections,
        )
        rgb_fingerprint = rgb_nine_result_sha256(nine)
        if (
            request.expected_rgb_nine_result_sha256 is not None
            and request.expected_rgb_nine_result_sha256 != rgb_fingerprint
        ):
            raise ValueError("shared RGB nine-result fingerprint mismatch")

        clinic = None
        clinic_fallback_used = False
        if request.route == "clinic_four_light":
            staged_clinic = stage_fast3_fixture(
                request.clinic_modality_root,
                output / "evidence" / "clinic_modality",
            )
            fast3_path = staged_clinic / "fast3_structured_result.json"
            fast3 = Fast3StructuredResult.model_validate_json(
                fast3_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            )
            if fast3.capture_alias != request.capture_alias:
                raise ValueError("clinic modality fixture capture does not match RGB result")
            validate_clinic_manifest_binding(
                input_count=request.input_count,
                submitted_sha256=request.input_manifest_sha256,
                fast3_manifest_sha256=fast3.manifest_sha256,
            )
            clinic = clinic_modality_bundle_from_fast3_fixture(
                fast3,
                artifact_prefix="evidence/clinic_modality",
            )
            if request.clinic_modality_fallback_root is not None:
                staged_fallback = stage_fast3_fixture(
                    request.clinic_modality_fallback_root,
                    output / "evidence" / "clinic_modality_fallback",
                )
                fallback = Fast3StructuredResult.model_validate_json(
                    (staged_fallback / "fast3_structured_result.json").read_text(
                        encoding="utf-8"
                    )
                )
                if fallback.capture_alias != request.capture_alias:
                    raise ValueError("clinic fallback capture does not match RGB result")
                fallback_bundle = clinic_modality_bundle_from_fast3_fixture(
                    fallback,
                    artifact_prefix="evidence/clinic_modality_fallback",
                )
                clinic = _merge_clinic_modality_cache(clinic, fallback_bundle)
                clinic_fallback_used = True

        snapshot = adapt_nine_result_bundle(nine, clinic)
        delivery, delivery_receipt = materialize_three_report_delivery(
            snapshot,
            sample_root=output,
            output_root=output / "reports",
            formal_artifacts=request.formal_artifacts,
        )
        route_receipt = output / "dual_route_receipt.json"
        route_receipt.write_bytes(
            canonical_json_bytes(
                {
                    "schema_version": "doctor_v2_dual_route_receipt_v1",
                    "route": request.route,
                    "input_count": request.input_count,
                    "input_manifest_sha256": request.input_manifest_sha256,
                    "capture_alias": request.capture_alias,
                    "rgb_nine_result_sha256": rgb_fingerprint,
                    "clinic_auxiliary_present": clinic is not None,
                    "clinic_fallback_cache_used": clinic_fallback_used,
                    "clinic_auxiliary_changes_rgb_results": False,
                    "delivery_receipt_sha256": file_sha256(delivery_receipt),
                    "medical_ready_count": "0/11",
                    "worker_v1_modified": False,
                }
            )
            + b"\n"
        )
        return DoctorV2RunResult(
            route=request.route,
            capture_alias=request.capture_alias,
            rgb_nine_result_sha256=rgb_fingerprint,
            delivery=delivery,
            delivery_receipt=delivery_receipt,
            route_receipt=route_receipt,
        )


def _merge_clinic_modality_cache(
    primary: ClinicModalityEvidenceBundle,
    fallback: ClinicModalityEvidenceBundle,
) -> ClinicModalityEvidenceBundle:
    """Fill missing modality heads from a hash-identical accepted prior run.

    This is an explicit cache reuse path for a temporarily unavailable CUDA
    runtime.  It never replaces a primary head with an older one and it refuses
    to combine different inputs, registration receipts or capture identities.
    """

    if primary.capture_alias != fallback.capture_alias:
        raise ValueError("clinic modality cache capture mismatch")
    primary_channels = {
        row.role: (
            row.input_sha256,
            row.registration_status,
            row.registration_transform_sha256,
        )
        for row in primary.channel_status
    }
    fallback_channels = {
        row.role: (
            row.input_sha256,
            row.registration_status,
            row.registration_transform_sha256,
        )
        for row in fallback.channel_status
    }
    if primary_channels != fallback_channels:
        raise ValueError("clinic modality cache input or registration mismatch")
    merged: dict[str, tuple] = {}
    for module_id in sorted(set(fallback.module_heads) | set(primary.module_heads)):
        by_id = {head.head_id: head for head in fallback.module_heads.get(module_id, ())}
        by_id.update({head.head_id: head for head in primary.module_heads.get(module_id, ())})
        merged[module_id] = tuple(by_id[key] for key in sorted(by_id))
    return ClinicModalityEvidenceBundle(
        capture_alias=primary.capture_alias,
        channel_status=primary.channel_status,
        module_heads=merged,
    )

def _bounded_artifact(sample_root: Path, relative_path: str) -> Path:
    root = sample_root.resolve(strict=True)
    target = (root / relative_path).resolve(strict=True)
    if not target.is_relative_to(root) or target.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("evidence artifact escaped the sample root")
    return target


def _string(value: Any, *, limit: int = 800) -> str:
    text = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 1] + "…"

def _copy_role(source: Path, target: Path) -> Path:
    if not source.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(source)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if target.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(target)
    shutil.copyfile(source, target)
    if file_sha256(source) != file_sha256(target):
        raise RuntimeError(f"formal report copy hash mismatch: {source.name}")
    return target


def _sanitize_json_paths(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(key): _sanitize_json_paths(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [_sanitize_json_paths(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return [_sanitize_json_paths(item) for item in value]

<proposed_plan>
# DermaVision 十二项结果与Word同源快速修复

## 总结

继续在 `fix/unified-twelve-output-format-lzt-0818 @ b5e83f5` 修复，不改核心算法、不重写报告模板、不合并主目录。

本轮只解决：

- 删除红区、棕区重复实例图。
- 油光恢复Word同款天蓝线框。
- Clinic血管固定使用Word同款V3结果图。
- `run.py`默认同时生成用户精简版和医生详细版。
- Word直接引用十二项输出图片，不再重新生成另一套图片。

## 关键修改

### 1. 红区、棕区去重

每项公开目录只保留：

- `00_厂家RED/BROWN底图`
- `01_红区/棕区检测结果图`：厂家底图＋天蓝分区线＋特征点

删除：

- `02_VISIA红色特征点实例图`
- `02_VISIA棕色斑实例图`

同步修改导出器、索引、公开产物基数门禁和测试；检测Mask与指标不变。

### 2. 油光、血管与Word统一

- consumer和Clinic油光最终图统一经过现有VISIA公共边界函数，保留原油光Mask和指标，只增加天蓝边界。
- Clinic血管固定调用现有`VascularStructure-V3-Clinic`，以RED底图绘制深橙色血管样中心线和分支点，不增加天蓝框。
- 单RGB血管继续使用RGB V2.1，不与Clinic V3混用；各路线Word分别引用自己的实际结果。
- Word不得重新渲染油光或血管图片，必须直接嵌入十二项索引中的主结果图，确保文件SHA同源。

### 3. `run.py`接入正式双版报告

- 将`GENERATE_MEDICAL_REPORT_DEFAULT`设为`True`。
- 开关改为布尔双向参数：
  - 默认生成报告。
  - `--no-generate-medical-report`可关闭，供大批量运行使用。
- 移除四光源模式禁止生成Word的旧限制。
- 新增十二项正式报告适配入口，复用现有V0.1.2正式聚合、评分和渲染器，不创建新模板或新报告体系。
- 固定十二项到医生11章的映射：
  - 01毛孔←毛孔
  - 02油脂←油光＋卟啉
  - 03综合色素←可见斑点＋UV色斑＋棕区
  - 04泛红←红区
  - 05血管←血管样结构
  - 06痤疮←痤疮
  - 07–09←成熟皱纹链的三张专用分区图
  - 10光滑度←纹理
  - 11紧致度←轮廓紧致度
- 报告直接读取同一次运行生成的图片、JSON和CSV；不重新运行算法、不复制历史测试结果。
- 每个样本目录新增：
  - `正式报告/AISIA_<样本>_用户精简版.docx`
  - `正式报告/AISIA_<样本>_医生详细版.docx`
- `十二项检测结果索引.json`只新增两份报告相对路径，不改变Worker五字段信封或云端字段。

## 验证

1. 先运行`clinic28-25`一套作为快速门禁。
2. 通过后串行运行clinic28-09、23及三张单RGB。
3. 必须确认：
   - 红区、棕区各只有底图和最终检测图。
   - 油光图存在天蓝统一边界，Mask和指标逐字段不变。
   - Clinic血管图与正式Word使用同一V3图片，且无天蓝外框。
   - 两份Word中每张检测图SHA均能在同样本十二项目录找到。
   - 02保留油光和卟啉两图；03保留Visible、UV、Brown多证据结构。
   - 07–09使用成熟皱纹专用分区图，不使用通用单图替代。
   - Word保持VISIA2版式、11章、13书签、页眉页脚、评分和建议。
   - 无绝对路径、内部文件名、算法ID或调试措辞。
4. 运行定向报告测试、十二项导出测试、Worker合同测试和`git diff --check`，不运行全仓库、13例、28套或厂家Exact。
5. 修改、失败、耗时、峰值RSS和输出路径写入`DUAL_ROUTE_RUNTIME_EXECUTION_LOG.md`，建立本地Git检查点；不合并、不推送、不部署。
</proposed_plan>

class TwelveOutputExporter:
    """Materialize one canonical twelve-item tree and legacy index aliases."""

    def __init__(self, output_root: Path) -> None:
        self.output_root = output_root.resolve()
        self.output_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    @staticmethod
    def _copy(source: str | Path | None, target: Path) -> Path:
        if source is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing source for {target.name}")
        path = Path(source)
        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size <= 0:
            raise FileNotFoundError(path)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(path, target)
        return target

    @staticmethod
    def _relative(path: Path, root: Path) -> str:
        return path.relative_to(root).as_posix()

    def _medical_v2(
        self,
        item_id: str,
        item: dict[str, Any],
        item_root: Path,
        display_name: str,
    ) -> Path:
        target = item_root / f"{display_name}医学量化指标_V2.csv"
        explicit = item.get("医学V2CSV")
        if explicit and Path(explicit).is_file():
            return self._copy(explicit, target)
        if item_id in _V2_SOURCE_NAMES:
            candidate = Path(item["主结果图"]).parent / _V2_SOURCE_NAMES[item_id]
            if candidate.is_file():
                return self._copy(candidate, target)
        if item_id in {"wrinkle", "acne"}:
            raw = json.loads(Path(item["量化JSON"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
            report = build_wrinkle_report(raw) if item_id == "wrinkle" else build_acne_report(raw)
            write_medical_v2_report(report, item_id, target, None)
            return target
        # New engineering modules currently expose the same scalar set in
        # both compact and V2 CSVs.  Keep a physical V2 file without changing
        # the values or inventing a score.
        return self._copy(item["量化CSV"], target)

    def _export_item(
        self,
        definition,
        item: dict[str, Any],
        temporary: Path,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if item.get("状态") != "success":
            raise RuntimeError(f"{definition.display_name} did not succeed")
        item_root = temporary / "十二项检测" / definition.directory_name
        source_image = Path(item["主结果图"])
        suffix = source_image.suffix.lower() or ".jpg"
        main = self._copy(
            source_image,
            item_root / f"01_{definition.display_name}检测结果图{suffix}",
        )
        metric_json = item_root / f"{definition.display_name}量化指标.json"
        metric_csv = item_root / f"{definition.display_name}量化指标.csv"
        v2_csv = item_root / f"{definition.display_name}医学量化指标_V2.csv"
        if definition.item_id in {"wrinkle", "acne"}:
            raw = json.loads(Path(item["量化JSON"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))

                build_wrinkle_report(raw)
                if definition.item_id == "wrinkle"
                else build_acne_report(raw)
            )
            write_report_csv(report, metric_csv)
            medical = write_medical_v2_report(
                report, definition.item_id, v2_csv, None
            )
            metric_json.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    to_english_document(medical),
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                    indent=2,
                    allow_nan=False,
                ) + "\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        elif definition.item_id in {"uv_spots", "porphyrin"}:
            raw = json.loads(Path(item["量化JSON"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
            if raw.get("metrics_version") and isinstance(raw.get("overall_metrics"), dict):
                metric_json = self._copy(item["量化JSON"], metric_json)
                metric_csv = self._copy(item["量化CSV"], metric_csv)
                v2_csv = self._medical_v2(
                    definition.item_id, item, item_root, definition.display_name
                )
            else:

                metric_csv = self._copy(item["量化CSV"], metric_csv)

                    definition.item_id, item, item_root, definition.display_name
                )
            else:
                write_added_item_public_metrics(
                    item_id=definition.item_id,
                    raw=raw,
                    json_path=metric_json,
                    csv_path=metric_csv,
                    v2_path=v2_csv,
                )
        else:
            metric_json = self._copy(item["量化JSON"], metric_json)
            metric_csv = self._copy(item["量化CSV"], metric_csv)
            v2_csv = self._medical_v2(
                definition.item_id, item, item_root, definition.display_name
            )
        exported = {
            "项目": definition.display_name,
            "状态": "success",
            "主结果图": self._relative(main, temporary),
            "量化JSON": self._relative(metric_json, temporary),
            "量化CSV": self._relative(metric_csv, temporary),
            "医学V2CSV": self._relative(v2_csv, temporary),
        }
        additional: list[str] = []
        fixed_names = _ADDITIONAL_IMAGE_NAMES.get(definition.item_id, ())

            source_path = Path(source)

            suffix = source_path.suffix.lower() or ".jpg"
            copied = self._copy(source_path, item_root / f"{stem}{suffix}")
            additional.append(self._relative(copied, temporary))
        if additional:
            exported["附加结果图"] = additional
        return exported

    @staticmethod
    def _write_public_timing(source: Path, json_target: Path, csv_target: Path) -> None:
        raw = json.loads(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        services = raw.get("服务") or {}

            writer = csv.writer(handle)
